home.title: Phone-verified renovation contacts across Spain
home.subtitle: We check every client before publishing their request. You see the job, the area and the contact price before paying. Your monthly fee becomes balance to buy contacts.
home.heroTitle: The job is already <mark>checked</mark>. All that's left is your call.
home.heroSubtitle: We check every request before publishing it. You see the job, the area and the contact price, and you decide whether to buy it.

validation.title: A contact isn't published until it passes these three steps
validation.subtitle: The same process for every trade, no exceptions.

one.title: We check the request
one.body: We confirm the job is real and that the client wants quotes right now.

two.title: We record scope and area
two.body: What needs doing and where. The postal code sets the town and province you see on the card.

three.title: We publish with a fixed price
three.body: The contact goes live with its price visible. You know what it costs before you pay for it.

trades.title: Trades and contact price
trades.subtitle: The price shown is the trade's reference price. Each contact shows its exact price on its own card.
trades.note: Posting a request is free and you don't need an account.

why.title: Why buying here is different
why.subtitle: Four product rules that don't depend on anyone's goodwill: they are in the code.

cap.title: At most {maxProfessionals} professionals per request
cap.body: Every request is sold to {maxProfessionals} professionals and no more. You aren't competing against an endless list.

price.title: The contact price is visible before you pay
price.body: Every card carries its amount in plain sight. No bundles, no credit packs, no prices that change at checkout.

topup.title: Your monthly fee becomes balance
topup.body: Every month {amount} is charged and added to your balance to buy the contacts you choose. Browsing the listing costs nothing.

privacy.title: Only the buyer sees the client's phone
privacy.body: The public listing shows the job and the area only. The name and phone are handed over after payment.

pricing.headline: From {price} per contact
pricing.headlineFallback: You pay per contact. Nothing else.
pricing.body: With your monthly fee up to date, each contact is paid from your balance and the price is visible on every card. Each purchase keeps the amount you paid.

clientBanner.title: Planning a renovation?
clientBanner.body: Tell us what you need and we'll put you in touch with professionals in your area. Free, no account needed.

publish.title: Post your request
publish.lockNotice: No account needed. Only the professional who buys the contact sees your phone number.
publish.descriptionPlaceholder: Explain what needs doing, its current state and anything useful for the professional.
publish.descriptionHint: At least {min} characters. More detail means better quotes.
publish.postalCodeHint: Only in the Community of Madrid for now. Professionals see your postcode and town, never your address.
publish.photosHint: Up to {max} photos (JPG, PNG or WEBP, max 10 MB each).
publish.phoneHint: This is the key detail. Only professionals who buy your contact will see it.
publish.emailHint: We'll send you a copy of your request.
publish.consentLabel: I have read and accept the data processing policy. I authorise Voy a Reformar to process my data to validate the request, to show my first name and postcode to registered professionals and to share my contact details with up to {maxProfessionals} professionals who buy the contact, under GDPR (EU) 2016/679 and LOPDGDD 3/2018.

controller.body: Voy a Reformar. The full identifying details (legal name, address and privacy email) will be published in the complete policy.

purpose.body: To validate your renovation request and put you in touch with professionals in the trade you chose.

legitimation.body: Your explicit consent, which you can withdraw at any time.

recipients.body: Registered professionals see your first name, your postcode and what you need. Your full name, phone and email are only shared with at most {maxProfessionals} professionals who buy your contact.

retention.body: While the request remains active and for the statutory invoicing periods.

rights.body: Access, rectification, erasure, objection, restriction and portability, plus the right to complain to the AEPD.

publish.successBody: It's now visible to professionals in {city}. They will contact you directly using the details you gave us.
publish.propertyTypeLabel: What type of property is it?
publish.scheduleLabel: What is the current timing of your project?
publish.servicesHint: Optional. Tick one or more services.
publish.phoneCodeHint: We have sent it by text message to {phone}. Enter it to publish your request.

subscription.title: Monthly fee
subscription.subtitle: Every month {amount} is charged and added to your balance to buy contacts. Without an up-to-date top-up you can browse requests, but not buy them.
subscription.sepaNotice: You can pay by card or bank direct debit (SEPA). With direct debit, the first charge takes 2 to 5 days to be confirmed and you can't buy until then.
subscription.pendingNotice: We're waiting for the payment to be confirmed. As soon as it arrives you'll be able to buy contacts and the amount will be added to your balance.
subscription.pastDueNotice: We couldn't charge this month's top-up. Update your payment method to buy contacts again. Your balance is kept.
subscription.canceledNotice: Your top-up is canceled. You can still browse requests and your balance is kept; to buy, reactivate it.
subscription.checkoutSuccess: We've received your payment details. Your account will be activated once the charge is confirmed.
subscription.checkoutCancelled: You cancelled the payment. Your monthly fee hasn't been activated.

entry.chargeback: Monthly fee returned by the bank

subscription.bannerInactive: Inactive account: you can browse requests, but to buy contacts you need an up-to-date monthly top-up.
subscription.bannerDebt: Your bank returned a monthly fee you had already spent and you owe {debt}. You can browse requests, but not buy until your next monthly fee settles it.
subscription.debtNotice: Your bank returned a monthly fee you had already spent on contacts. {debt} is outstanding: it will be taken from your next monthly fee and, until then, you can't buy contacts.
